Bilt Points transfer 1:1 to airline and hotel partners. Points on rent require at least five transactions per statement period. Rewards on rent and housing payments are subject to limits described in the terms. The cards described on this page are issued by a partner bank. Card availability varies. This page is a test fixture written for card_agent tests; it is modeled on the structure of a card lineup page that lists several cards and is not a copy of one. It exists so tests can check that an extraction for a card that isn't on the page, or for the wrong card on the page, is rejected before any value is used. Additional filler text follows so the page has enough static text to count as readable: rent day offers, partner promotions, dining rewards, travel rewards, and neighborhood perks are all described in the terms and conditions.

Frequently asked questions. Which card is right for me? Compare annual fees, earning rates, and credits above; each card earns Bilt Points on rent without a transaction fee, subject to the program terms. Can I switch cards later? Product changes depend on the issuing bank's policies. Do points expire? Points do not expire while your account is open and in good standing. How do I redeem? Redeem for travel, rent, statement credits, or transfers to loyalty partners at the posted ratios.
